name: Central bank stress
value: Fed Dec rise priced ~90%; ECB rise expected
summary: Markets price about a 90% chance of a December Fed rate rise; Fed officials discuss faster moves and ECB set to raise
state: After hot October CPI, Dallas Fed President Logan backed two more rises and Governor Waller raised a possible half-point move; CME FedWatch put the chance of a December rise near 90% and a January rise above 64% (BNN Bloomberg, 11 Nov). US 10-year yields rose to 4.99% on 10 Nov after a weak 10-year auction (Saxo, 11 Nov). All 71 economists in a Reuters poll published 12 Nov expect the ECB to raise to 2.75% in December. Central banks face a stagflationary dilemma; no emergency move found.
for_you: Borrowers with variable-rate loans in the US and euro area are exposed to further rate rises. Savers' returns tend to rise with policy rates.
rubric_hit: Watch: stagflationary dilemma with rate rises priced as growth slows; no emergency inter-meeting move or attempt to remove a central-bank head

sources.title: BNN Bloomberg — US Fed officials consider faster hikes
Saxo — Market Quick Take: US Treasury yields rip higher, 11 November 2026
Investing.com (Reuters) — ECB set for last rate hike in December: Reuters poll

why: Central banks are the shock absorbers; when they are boxed in or their independence is challenged, markets lose their backstop.
drivers: Inflation vs growth trade-off, political pressure, currency moves, financial stability.

rubric.alert: Emergency inter-meeting moves, attempt to remove a central-bank head, or coordinated intervention.
rubric.watch: Stagflationary dilemma, open political pressure on a major central bank, or FX intervention by a G7 bank.
rubric.normal: Fed, ECB and BoJ acting orderly and on schedule; independence unquestioned.
